summary: Built scripts/gate-label.js + test/gate-label.test.js. Labeler reads .graph/gate-journal.jsonl, joins each row to its task's terminal outcome via /task/detail, emits four-quadrant labels (TP/FP/TN/FN) + all features to .graph/gate-labeled.jsonl. Includes note-used lexical proxy (topKey present OR >=0.5 note-content-token overlap in transcript+summary) and FN post-mortem matcher (/search?asOf=row.ts, FN if a note scores >=0.5). Idempotent/append-only (dedup by ts+task_key+query hash), fail-soft on daemon errors. Test 41/41 PASS incl FN quadrant + idempotency + null-task_key. Runs clean on real journal (50 rows, all currently unlabelable — no task_key yet, expected; the data clock just started). Worker subagent died mid test-harness debugging (spawnSync froze the parent event loop; fixed to async spawn) before calling complete_task — main agent verified files + reran test (41/41) + ran script (exit 0) and is closing it out. Labeling-policy choice flagged: inject+note_used+FAIL → labeled FP (inject didn't help despite note being read). Uncommitted. Follow-ups remain separate tasks: nightly-QA wiring + epsilon-exploration in the gate.
